judgment_pre_vs_lockbox.interpretation: Lockbox period (frozen weights) shows DRAMATICALLY different risk-return profile vs Pre-LB walk-forward. Pre-LB MDD 59.7% > 45% hurdle FAIL, but Lockbox MDD 17.2% << 45% hurdle PASS. SR ratio 5.54x (1.92 / 0.35). This is highly unusual — typical regime structure breaks point to: (a) overfitting on Pre-LB (less likely given walk-forward), (b) regime shift post-2023 favorable to defense+quality+value+consensus mix, (c) lucky 28-month window. The Pre-LB MDD COVID-2020 event (-60% trough 2020-03-23) is the operative hurdle violation.

hurdle_gate_lockbox.note: Lockbox MDD < hurdle threshold. However, Pre-LB MDD (which is the OFFICIAL backtest window per Forge) is FAIL.

judge_disposition.primary_basis: Pre-LB walk-forward backtest is the OFFICIAL hurdle measurement window (2016-2024 8-year). Lockbox is forward-looking validation, not historical hurdle test.
judge_disposition.rationale: Hurdle Gate (45% MDD) applies to the official backtest window. The strategy realized 59.7% MDD during 2018-02-2020-03 (COVID era). Lockbox 28-month favorable period cannot override the historical hurdle violation. Judge must judge on full historical record.
